text:
incident-bot: ALERT: continuous-batching service (cb-svc) experiencing high latency and error-rate spike. Paging on-call.
incident-bot: Symptoms: p95 latency jump from ~300ms to 6-9s, queue length rising, KV cache eviction rate spiked. Affected region: us-west-2 (some Dedicated nodes).
mari: taking pager — looking at traces + tailing logs now.
kevin: i'm on a call, will join in ~2m. if it's bad take lead.
mari: quick findings:
```
eviction_rate=450/s
microbatch_queue_len=avg 120 (recent peak 420)
p95=8.2s
error_rate=4.7% (timeouts / 504)
```
mari: looks like KVCACHE churn -> continuous-batch accumulation -> microbatches piling -> slow tails. Prefetch seems to be thrashing keys.
joan: confirmed similar in prod-canary. stack traces show long KV waits during prefetch path.
kevin: ok. mitigation options: 1) disable prefetch on router (temporary), 2) reduce max_microbatch_size to 6-8, 3) throttle cache refill (kv-evict-throttle) or bump TTL. prefer (2)+short disable prefetch canary first.
mari: agreed. proposing quick canary patch to 2 pods in us-west-2:
```
# reduce max microbatch and disable prefetch
kubectl -n cb patch deployment cb-router -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"cb-router","env":[{"name":"MAX_MICROBATCH_SIZE","value":"6"},{"name":"ENABLE_PREFETCH","value":"false"}]}]}}}}'
```
mari: applying to canary now.
kevin: good. also prepare an emergency rollback of router config and a traffic-shift to fallback model (low-latency variant) if we don't see improvement in 8m.
sre-bot: rollout started: deployment/cb-router updated (canary selector: us-west-2, replicas 2). watching health checks.
mari: patch applied — saw immediate drop in microbatch queue length on canary pods. p95 on canary dropped from 8s -> 420ms within 1m.
joan: nice. global p95 still high (because majority of traffic still on old config). recommend gradual ramp to additional pods + keep prefetch disabled for now.
customer-success: observed customer impact: three Dedicated customers in us-west reporting 5-12% request failures and increased tail latency. CS is drafting notices.
kevin: update incident page with customer list + mitigation steps. limit changes only until SLOs stable.
mari: kicked off instrumented rollout to additional 6 pods in region (manual step). monitoring dashboards: replication_stable=true, error_rate trending down.
incident-bot: NOTE: if error-rate > 2% or p95 > 1s for >10m, escalate to SEV2 and re-route traffic to small-latency fallback.
kevin: i'll take watch for next 20m. mari handing over at 18:07 PT. please ping me if anything spikes.
mari: handing off to @kevin — will stay on for 10m as observer. logs+commands are in thread above.
kevin: ack. i'll coordinate with CS for customer comms and prepare rollback plan (kubectl patch to revert env).
customer-success: sending initial status note to impacted customers now (template: /docs/incidents/templates/prefetch-thrash).
kevin: thanks — once p95 stable < 500ms for 10m we can move to postmortem. otherwise escalate.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigation in progress — canary success. monitoring continues.
